biotools.summary: spMOCA is a statistical model for gene co-expression analysis in spatial transcriptomics data, integrating spatial dependency and gene-gene interaction to provide a more accurate understanding of gene co-expression networks. It uses a matrix-normal model and is scalable to large datasets with tens of thousands of spatial locations and genes.
